create.name: April Walker
create.bio:
April Walker is an energy healer and teacher in Modesto, California, best known for her Reiki training. She has practised and taught Reiki full time since the mid-2000s and is licensed as a master teacher by the International Center for Reiki Training. She is also a certified Quantum-Touch practitioner and Level 1 instructor. She has more than thirty years of teaching behind her: she holds a master's degree in human development and has taught college courses in child development, psychology and human services, a background that shapes her structured, step-by-step classes.

Her school, Reiki Training Central, runs Usui and Holy Fire Reiki levels from beginner to master teacher, along with Karuna Reiki, animal Reiki, Kid Reiki, crystal work and Reiki drumming, in person in Modesto and Sonora and live on Zoom. She teaches the Quantum-Touch Becoming Energized workshop, which covers breathing, intention and body awareness for running life-force energy, toning and distance work. In her own practice she combines Reiki, Quantum-Touch, sound and crystal work with other energy methods, seeing clients in her Modesto office or remotely by phone and video, and she works with a small team of practitioners. She also holds free online Reiki shares and Quantum-Touch healing circles and records guided Reiki meditations.

courses.title: Energy healing sessions with April Walker
courses.description: One-to-one sessions that draw on Reiki, Quantum-Touch, sound and crystal work, in her Modesto office, by phone, on Zoom or remotely. Single sessions, six-session packages and a monthly membership are offered.

courses.title: Reiki Drumming
courses.description: A two-day class in Modesto and on Zoom that brings rhythm and drumming into Reiki practice for meditation and connection. Open to anyone with Reiki I and II from any lineage; the fee includes a drum.

courses.title: Reiki Master Training - Holy Fire III
courses.description: Three days of master-level Holy Fire Reiki training in Modesto and online, for students who completed Reiki I and II at least six months earlier.

courses.title: Holy Fire Karuna Training
courses.description: Advanced Karuna Reiki training for Reiki masters, held in Modesto and on Zoom over three days.

courses.title: Usui Holy Fire III - Reiki 1 + 2 Training
courses.description: A two-day beginner course in Modesto and online. Students learn where Reiki comes from, its principles and symbols, how to give a treatment to themselves and others, and how to send it at a distance. No previous experience is needed.

free_resources.title: Guided Reiki meditations
free_resources.description: Free recorded meditations on April's site, including a seasonal autumn Reiki meditation for self-nurturing and a spring renewal practice for letting go. Each is meant to be listened to lying down in a quiet room.
